About Leena AILeena AI is a pioneer in Agentic AI Colleagues for enterprises - voice-enabled, personified AI coworkers prebuilt for IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement. They automate complex workflows across existing systems like Workday, ServiceNow, and SAP.

Through the AI Colleague Studio, companies can customize or build new AI Colleagues fast, achieving ROI at scale. Founded in 2018, Leena AI is trusted by Fortune 500 leaders worldwide.
